   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 28, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Christoffer Poulsen_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "I don't know what they've done to the app, but it's absolutely unusably slow. Half the time the UI just plainly refuses to load. I continue to use Yahoo finance on the web, but the fact that YF links force the app to open when browsing on my phone, makes the app more of a detriment than a help - to the point where I just uninstalled. Also, please give us a way to filter news so I don't have to skim past a dozen Motley Fool articles to find something actually informative."
            2. _Every_Day_ Day_, Jul 17, 2026, 1/5: "this is the worst app I stalled on my device garbage always freezes never works at 9am stock charts cross....webull is the best do not dow load thos garbage"
            3. _Fred K_, Jul 17, 2026, 2/5: "at times the application is buggy. Unable to view details of a tracked value. sometimes a simple force shutdown and clearing the cache is enough, sometimes you have to uninstall/reinstall... it's a shame"
